tools.name: benchling_list_projects
tools.description: List projects in the tenant (GET /projects). Use to find a projectId for other list calls.

tools.name: benchling_list_folders
tools.description: List folders (GET /folders). Filter by projectId, parent folder, or name.

tools.name: benchling_list_entries
tools.description: List notebook entries (GET /entries). Filter by project, schema, name, or modifiedAt (ISO time, Benchling filter syntax).

tools.name: benchling_get_entry
tools.description: Get one notebook entry by id (GET /entries/{entry_id}).

tools.name: benchling_list_dna_sequences
tools.description: List DNA sequences (GET /dna-sequences). Filter by project, folder, registry, schema, or name.

tools.name: benchling_get_dna_sequence
tools.description: Get one DNA sequence by id, including its bases (GET /dna-sequences/{dna_sequence_id}).

tools.name: benchling_list_registries
tools.description: List registries (GET /registries). Use to find a registryId for DNA sequence and entity calls.

tools.name: benchling_list_users
tools.description: List users in the tenant (GET /users). Filter by name or by team membership.

tools.name: benchling_list_teams
tools.description: List teams (GET /teams), optionally filtered by name or organization.

tools.name: benchling_create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder inside a parent folder (POST /folders). Creates a new record in the tenant; it does not change existing records.
